visual.general_description: Twelve-lead ECG tracing on pink grid paper with a printed blue annotation reading SVT at 178 bpm.
visual.detailed_description: Black ECG traces on a pink millimetre grid are arranged in two columns of six rows. The left column carries leads I, II, III, aVR, aVL and aVF, each row starting with a rectangular calibration pulse; the right column carries leads V1 to V6. Lead labels are small dark-blue letters. A row of small blue downward arrows (15 counted by eye) lies above the lead II rhythm strip, and the bold blue text "SVT at 178 bpm" is printed below it. The complexes in every lead are narrow, evenly spaced and fast; the precordial leads show larger deflections than the limb leads. No patient name, identifier, date, device text, paper-speed or gain label is visible.

No patient name, identifier, date or scanner text is visible and the CTR value is not printed on the image.

visual.general_description: Dual-axis line chart of heart rate and LVEF with printed data labels and three drug-administration bars beneath it.
visual.detailed_description: A line chart with a left axis in bpm (ticks 0 to 160 in steps of 20) and a right axis in percent (ticks 0 to 60 in steps of 10). The x tick labels run 36w0d to 36w6d, 37w0d to 37w4d, then POD1 to POD9 and are rotated; the x axis has no printed title. Headers printed at the top read (Antepartum), (Delivery) and (Postpartum); the plot background has a pale lilac shading over the antepartum part and is white afterwards. A legend in the lower left shows a solid blue line with circle markers for HR [bpm] and a dotted green line with triangle markers for LVEF [%]. The blue HR series carries 21 printed data labels; read left to right they are 150, 125, 108, 102, 95, 94, 83, 78, 76, 75, 76, 68, 80, 64, 68, 68, 68, 83, 83, 82, 80. The green LVEF series carries five printed data labels; read left to right they are 30, 30, 43, 54, 54. HR labels fall steeply early in the antepartum part and then change little, with small rises in the postpartum part. LVEF labels rise and the last two carry the same value. Beneath the plot are three horizontal bars: a dark grey bar labelled "IV UFH (10,000 U/d)", a cyan bar labelled "Oral spironolactone (25 mg/d)" that begins later and extends to the right end, and a mid-blue bar labelled "Bisoprolol transdermal patch (2 → 4 → 2 mg/d)" that is stepped: a lower-height strip starts at the same left edge as the UFH bar, rises to full height where the label is printed, and steps back down to the lower height near its right end, continuing to the right edge. No patient name, identifier, date or device text is visible.
